title: Walk the Line
tagline: Black suit. Big voice. A long road to June.

Warm roasted peanuts with smoky chilli salt.How to make it400g raw shelled peanuts1 tbsp peanut oil1 tsp smoked paprika1/2 tsp cayenne pepper1 tsp brown sugar1 tsp sea salt flakesToss the peanuts with the oil and spread on a tray.Roast at 180°C, shaking once, until golden.Toss hot with the paprika, cayenne, sugar and salt, then cool a little.Dyess farm biscuits and sausage gravyJ.R.'s boyhood on the Dyess cotton farm. Buttermilk biscuits under peppery gravy.How to make it300g self-raising flour90g cold butter, cubed250ml buttermilk300g pork sausage mince2 tbsp plain flour500ml milk1 tsp cracked black pepperRub the butter into the flour with a pinch of salt, then stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough.Pat out 3cm thick, cut 8 rounds and bake at 220°C until risen and golden.Brown the sausage mince, breaking it up, then stir in the plain flour.Whisk in the milk and simmer until thick, then season with plenty of pepper.Split the biscuits and ladle over the gravy.Hot lineHendersonville Thanksgiving turkeyThanksgiving at the lake house. Roast turkey with cornbread stuffing.How to make it1.5kg turkey breast roast60g butter, softened4 sage leaves, chopped300g day-old cornbread, crumbled1 brown onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced250ml chicken stock, plus 250ml for the gravy1 egg2 tbsp plain flour4 tbsp cranberry sauceRub the turkey with half the butter, the sage and salt, and roast at 180°C until the juices run clear.Soften the onion and celery in the rest of the butter, then mix with the cornbread, egg and 250ml stock.Bake the stuffing in a dish alongside the turkey for the last 35 minutes.Rest the turkey, stir the flour into the pan juices, whisk in the rest of the stock and simmer to a gravy.Slice and serve with the stuffing, gravy and cranberry sauce.Sun Records Memphis dry-rub ribsThe audition for Sam Phillips at Sun. Slow pork ribs in a Memphis spice rub.How to make it1.5kg American-style pork ribs2 tbsp brown sugar2 tbsp sweet paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp onion powder1 tsp mustard powder1/2 tsp cayenne pepper125ml cider vinegar1/4 white cabbage, shredded3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaiseMix the sugar, spices and 2 tsp salt and rub all over the ribs.Wrap in foil with a splash of the vinegar and bake at 150°C until tender.Unwrap, sprinkle with a little more rub and roast at 220°C until crusted.Toss the cabbage with the mayo and the rest of the vinegar.Cut the ribs and serve with the slaw.SweetsRing of Fire cinnamon bundt cakeJune writes Ring of Fire about John. Brown sugar ring cake with hot cinnamon glaze.How to make it250g butter, softened250g brown sugar4 eggs300g self-raising flour2 tsp ground cinnamon250ml buttermilk150g icing sugar2 tbsp milk1/4 tsp cayenne pepperBeat the butter and brown sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.Fold in the flour and half the cinnamon, alternating with the buttermilk.Spoon into a greased bundt tin and bake at 170°C until a skewer comes out clean.Whisk the icing sugar, milk, the rest of the cinnamon and the cayenne, and pour over the cooled ring.DrinksFolsom yellow water lemonadeCash smashes his glass of yellow water.
